note: Items marked measured are database query results. Items marked inferred are one person's spot checks (one rater, no second check) and are rough estimates.

caveats.detail: 39 of 40 randomly sampled matched rows were correct, one rater. The one error (a course title taken for Nielsen's book) is now handled by marking that book 'generic'.

caveats.claim: About 6 of 138 offerings are not course pages.
caveats.detail: Study-programme pages and module handbooks (TU Darmstadt, UiO) and one research paper. A MOOC redirect is now rejected.

caveats.claim: Term, instructor and level are heuristic and weaker than titles and books.
caveats.detail: See measured.offerings_with_term, offerings_with_instructor and courses_level_unknown. The course-code field has occasional junk (a room number, a navigation code).

caveats.claim: Counts are cumulative over two decades, not current.
caveats.detail: Search surfaces archived offerings; see measured.offerings_before_2015 / 2015_2020 / 2021_on / year_unknown. Filter by year for a current view.

caveats.claim: Coverage is near complete for North America and falls off elsewhere.
caveats.detail: Mostly a discovery problem: one search index finds few course pages for Iran, China and Japan; Moodle/Canvas/Ed content is behind logins and is not reached by design; some sites are JavaScript apps.

caveats.claim: Aalto's only 'course' is a false positive.
caveats.detail: It is a research paper about a syllabus, so Finland is effectively 0 of 2.

caveats.claim: Unmatched citations are catalogue gaps, not errors.
caveats.detail: They are citation-like lines under a textbook/references heading with no catalogue match (confidence 0.30).

caveats.claim: Catalogue ISBNs are verified, except one.
caveats.detail: Checked against Open Library; Bach's 'Learning Theory from First Principles' returned 404 and is not confirmed.

caveats.claim: Downloaded materials are only the public PDF/PPTX slides and notes linked from course pages.
caveats.detail: Video, homework, exams, HTML/Google-Drive links and anything behind a login are not downloaded. Failures are listed per reason in pipeline.json.
